content_preview.title: IBM and Red Hat Expand Lightwell With Commercial Offerings to Secure Open Source Software Supply Chains
content_preview.summary: IBM and Red Hat launched commercial Lightwell offerings on July 8, building on their $5 billion pledge to secure open source software supply chains.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

IBM and Red Hat expanded Project Lightwell on July 8 with two new commercial offerings, Lightwell Network and Lightwell Clearinghouse Premier, designed to help enterprises patch and consume open source software at scale, according to [IBM Newsroom](https://newsroom.ibm.com/2026-07-08-ibm-and-red-hat-expand-lightwell-with-new-commercial-offerings-to-build-the-trust-infrastructure-for-ai-era-open-source). The launch builds on a $5 billion commitment to open source security that IBM an...
